why: Both concern responses to damage or attack, and this batch's duck and Eesti strands mix alarms/defence with cleaning/repair.

why.T3-005: The item is an alarm-and-defence cycle: warnings of an attack, calls to defend the duck, asking others to keep it alive, and going to help against the void/Mexico, which satisfies T3-005 rather than repair-only T3-021.

why.T3-149: The item turns pixel replacement into a peace/truce deal: offering to stop attacking for a sombrero, announcing a peaceful negotiation, accepting the deal, and recounting the agreement.
why.T3-153: It also has a distinct chat-negotiation strand: inviting Duck Game into Mexico's Discord, moving deal talk into Mexico's r/place chat, and inviting allies into an international Discord channel.
why.T3-150: It forms a continuing alliance: Mexico defending an allied duck, offering an alliance to protect both works, and naming the Sombrero Duck Alliance.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-149 carries the peace/truce terms but not the distinct move of negotiating them in Mexico's Discord and an international chat.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: The item has three chat-meeting concepts: inviting Duck Game into Mexico's Discord, moving deal talk into Mexico's r/place chat, and inviting allies into an international Discord channel.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-153 is dispensable if forced to one; we would lose the fact that the negotiation happened in Discord rather than in the threads.

multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-150 is dispensable if forced to one; we would lose the named alliance and promise of mutual defence.
